HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_BADGE.title: Ho'olheyak's Badge
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_BADGE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_BADGE.short_descr: At the start of combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK_BADGE.flavor: Caster Operator Ho'olheyak wanders the river of history.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.title: "Bibliotheca"
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Analysis[/gold], [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Erudition[/gold], and [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.short_descripti: At the start of combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Analysis[/gold], [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Erudition[/gold], and [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.flavor: Memory is like a library. Of course, not all libraries hold the same number of books.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FRENZIED_SUNDIAL.title: Frenzied Star Dial
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FRENZIED_SUNDIAL.descriptio: At the start of each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and enter a random [gold]Aspect[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FRENZIED_SUNDIAL.short_desc: At the start of each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and enter a random [gold]Aspect[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.title: Star Map Projection
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.descrip: For most [gold]Variables[/gold], you may spend an additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to activate all their effects at once.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.short_d: For most [gold]Variables[/gold], you may spend an additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to activate all their effects at once.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.flavor: Many first turn to astrology out of nothing more than curiosity about the day they will die.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.title: Old Notes
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.description: For every [blue]5[/blue] Attacks you draw, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Erudition[/gold]. For every [blue]5[/blue] Skills you draw, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.short_description: For every [blue]5[/blue] Attacks you draw, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Erudition[/gold]. For every [blue]5[/blue] Skills you draw, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.flavor: These pages contain a wealth of valuable research material. As for how it was acquired...
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.title: Time Gallery of K'uk'ulkan
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.description: The first card of each type you play each combat is played [blue]1[/blue] additional time.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.short_descripti: The first card of each type you play each combat is played [blue]1[/blue] additional time.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.flavor: Fools build walls; philosophers tear them down. And sometimes the reverse... History is a fascinating archive, bound to hold hints of the future. After all, history was once the future of countless generations.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COCKTAIL_SHAKER.title: Cocktail Shaker
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COCKTAIL_SHAKER.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]3[/blue] Max HP. Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card of another color, heal [blue]1[/blue] HP.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COCKTAIL_SHAKER.short_descr: Upon pickup, gain [blue]3[/blue] Max HP. Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card of another color, heal [blue]1[/blue] HP.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.title: Tail Care Kit
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.description: At the start of combat, apply [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Deconstruction[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.short_descrip: At the start of combat, apply [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Deconstruction[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.flavor: "Oi! Do you prefer thick tails or thin ones?"
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.desc:
At the start of combat, enemies you have defeated earlier this run lose [blue]50%[/blue] of their Max HP.
(Right-click to view the list.)
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.shor:
At the start of combat, enemies you have defeated earlier this run lose [blue]50%[/blue] of their Max HP.
(Right-click to view the list.)
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.flav: The same trick won't fool a clever mind twice.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.sele: Choose a starting Strike or Defend to transform into a random Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.desc: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] starting Strike or Defend in your deck and transform it into a random Colorless card. If none can be transformed, obtain [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Rare[/gold] Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.shor: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] starting Strike or Defend in your deck and transform it into a random Colorless card. If none can be transformed, obtain [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Rare[/gold] Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.flav: Those constellations, planets, and trajectories are metaphors, not commands.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BOTTLED_CLOUD.title: Bottled Cloud
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BOTTLED_CLOUD.flavor: "Wonderful! Now I am allowed to double jump!"
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.title: Weather Balloon
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.description: Whenever an enemy gains [gold]Levitation[/gold], apply [blue]5[/blue] additional [gold]Lift[/gold] to it.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.short_descr: Whenever an enemy gains [gold]Levitation[/gold], apply [blue]5[/blue] additional [gold]Lift[/gold] to it.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.flavor: "Daring to rival the heavens in height."
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.title: Zodiac Model
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.description: When an enemy's intent differs from its previous turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Lift[/gold] to it.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.short_descript: When an enemy's intent differs from its previous turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Lift[/gold] to it.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.flavor: Feathers dampened by forest dew, a tail brushing ruined stone pillars... and knowledge passes from one generation to the next.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.title: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.descripti: At the start of Elite or Boss combat, apply [gold]Lift[/gold] equal to half of each enemy's [gold]Gravity[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.short_des: At the start of Elite or Boss combat, apply [gold]Lift[/gold] equal to half of each enemy's [gold]Gravity[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.flavor: The sky above Trimounts is whole again, but surely no one can forget what lay beyond its torn veil.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PURE_WATER_SPRITE_ASSIST.de:
At the start of combat, summon a [gold]Flowing Shape[/gold] with 16 HP. While alive, it takes each entire instance of enemy damage in your place. It revives at full HP 3 turns after being defeated.
At the end of your turn, it performs a random action: Deal 3 damage 3 times to a random enemy; gain 12 Block; or grant you and itself 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] each.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PURE_WATER_SPRITE_ASSIST.sh:
At the start of combat, summon a [gold]Flowing Shape[/gold] with 16 HP. While alive, it takes each entire instance of enemy damage in your place. It revives at full HP 3 turns after being defeated.
At the end of your turn, it performs a random action: Deal 3 damage 3 times to a random enemy; gain 12 Block; or grant you and itself 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] each.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PURE_WATER_SPRITE_ASSIST.fl: "Just so we are clear, this is a one-time favor."
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FAILED_EXPERIMENT_PRODUCT.d: Congratulations! Your experiments have failed [red]{FailureCount}[/red] times.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FAILED_EXPERIMENT_PRODUCT.s: Congratulations! Your experiments have failed [red]{FailureCount}[/red] times.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.title: Eyes of the Priestess
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.descripti: When drawing your opening hand after each shuffle, look at the top [blue]5[/blue] cards of your draw pile. Choose up to [blue]5[/blue] cards. [gold]Variable[/gold]: [gold]Discard them[/gold]; [gold]Put them on the bottom of your draw pile[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.short_des: When drawing your opening hand after each shuffle, look at the top [blue]5[/blue] cards of your draw pile. Choose up to [blue]5[/blue] cards. [gold]Variable[/gold]: [gold]Discard them[/gold]; [gold]Put them on the bottom of your draw pile[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.flavor: Enter your dreams. Shape your dreams.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.list: Includes earlier battles in this run, before obtaining the history book.
